goal: Build and deploy a Telegram bot that helps women find beauty salons (nails, hair, eyebrows, lashes, waxing, massage, makeup) near them, with inline keyboards, location sharing, and rich HTML formatting. Ported from the existing WhatsApp beauty bot.

tasks.title: Initialize workspace: package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, install dependencies (typescript, tsx, node-telegram-bot-api types, axios, node-cache)
tasks.notes: Created package.json with all required deps (node-telegram-bot-api, @types/node-telegram-bot-api, axios, node-cache, tsx, typescript). Created tsconfig.json targeting ES2022/CommonJS. .gitignore was already present. npm install completed successfully with 198 packages.

tasks.title: Create src/ directory structure: index.ts, bot.ts, sessionStore.ts, salonSearch.ts, messageFormatter.ts, types.ts
tasks.notes: Created all 6 TypeScript source files. types.ts defines Session, Salon, ServiceType, BudgetLevel, BotState. sessionStore.ts uses in-memory Map with TTL (no NodeCache). salonSearch.ts uses native fetch instead of axios, supports GPS coords directly. messageFormatter.ts uses HTML parse mode with InlineKeyboardMarkup builders. bot.ts implements full state machine with text + location + callback_query handlers. index.ts loads credentials.env, starts polling, wires handlers with graceful shutdown. tsc --noEmit passes cleanly.

milestones.title: Core modules: session store, salon search, formatters

tasks.title: Write src/types.ts: Session, Salon, ServiceType, BudgetLevel, BotState types
tasks.notes: types.ts complete: BotState enum (GREETING/SERVICE_TYPE/LOCATION/BUDGET/SEARCHING/RESULTS/BOOKING), ServiceType union (nails|hair|eyebrows|lashes|waxing|massage|makeup|general), BudgetLevel (1|2|3|4), Salon interface (id/name/address/lat/lon/phone/website/opening_hours/rating/user_ratings_total/price_level/source/distance/score), ResolvedLocation interface, Session interface (chatId/state/serviceType/location/budgetLevel/salons/selectedSalon/resolvedLocation).

tasks.title: Port src/sessionStore.ts from WhatsApp sessionStore.js — in-memory Map with TTL, typed with Session interface
tasks.notes: sessionStore.ts was already fully implemented during m1.t2. Uses plain Map<number, {session, timer}> with setTimeout for TTL (no NodeCache). Keys by chatId (number). Exports getSession, saveSession, resetSession, and STATES (re-exported as BotState enum). freshSession() returns a typed Session with all nullable fields initialized. timer.unref() prevents the timer from keeping the process alive.

tasks.title: Port src/salonSearch.ts from WhatsApp salonSearch.js — resolveLocation (Nominatim), searchOSM (Overpass), searchGoogle (Places fallback), rankSalons, findSalons
tasks.notes: salonSearch.ts was already fully implemented during m1.t2. Uses native fetch (not axios). resolveLocation handles GPS coord strings and Nominatim geocoding. searchOSM posts to Overpass API with service-specific shop tags + amenity=massage filter. searchGoogle calls Places nearbysearch with placeType mapping. rankSalons uses 35% adjustedRating + 35% distance + 20% budget + 10% reviewConfidence weights. findSalons accepts optional gpsCoords to skip Nominatim for Telegram location messages. tsc --noEmit passes cleanly.

tasks.title: Port src/messageFormatter.ts from WhatsApp messageFormatter.js — adapt to HTML parse mode (Telegram), add inline keyboard builders for service/budget/results/navigation
tasks.notes: messageFormatter.ts was already fully implemented during m1.t2 scaffolding. Uses HTML parse mode throughout (<b>, <i>, <a href>). esc() helper escapes &, <, > for safe HTML insertion. Inline keyboards: service grid (2x4 InlineKeyboardMarkup), budget row (4 buttons in one row), results list (one button per salon + New Search nav row), salon detail (Call/Directions URL buttons + Back+New Search). formatLocationPrompt returns ReplyKeyboardMarkup with GPS location share button. parseServiceType and parseBudgetLevel ported unchanged. tsc --noEmit passes cleanly.

tasks.title: Write src/bot.ts — Telegram message handler: port WhatsApp state machine, handle text messages + location messages + /start + /help commands
tasks.notes: src/bot.ts was implemented during m1.t2 scaffolding. Full state machine: SERVICE_TYPE→LOCATION→BUDGET→SEARCHING→RESULTS→BOOKING. handleMessage handles text + msg.location (GPS skip geocoding) + /start + /help. handleCallbackQuery handles service:, budget:, salon:, action: callback data. doSearch helper sends searching message then calls findSalons with optional gpsCoords. Uses HTML parse mode throughout. tsc --noEmit passes cleanly.

tasks.title: Write src/bot.ts callback query handler — handle service selection, budget selection, result selection, back/new-search navigation via callback_data
tasks.notes: handleCallbackQuery was already fully implemented in bot.ts as part of m3.t1. Parses callback_data by splitting on ':' to get [action, value]. Calls answerCallbackQuery immediately. Handles: service:* (reset session, set serviceType, move to LOCATION), budget:* (parseInt budgetLevel, call doSearch), salon:* (lookup by index, show detail), action:back (restore RESULTS state, re-send results), action:new (full reset, send greeting). tsc --noEmit passes cleanly.

tasks.title: Write src/index.ts — entry point: load .env (TG_BOT_TOKEN), create TelegramBot in polling mode, wire message + callback_query handlers, graceful shutdown
tasks.notes: src/index.ts was already fully implemented during m1.t2 scaffolding. Manually parses ~/.agent-factory/credentials.env (skipping already-set keys), checks for TG_BOT_TOKEN (exits with error if missing), creates TelegramBot with polling:true, wires bot.on('message') to handleMessage and bot.on('callback_query') to handleCallbackQuery, handles polling_error and error events with console.error, and registers SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers that call bot.stopPolling() then process.exit(0). tsc --noEmit passes cleanly.

tasks.title: Run bot locally with 'npx tsx src/index.ts', verify startup, test /start command end-to-end (service → location → budget → results flow)
tasks.notes: Bot starts cleanly in polling mode with no TypeScript errors. OSM Overpass returns 5 nail salons for Tel Aviv. Full conversation flow tested with mock bot: /start → greeting with 8-service inline keyboard, service:nails callback → location prompt with GPS share button, text location → budget inline keyboard, budget:2 callback → searching message + top 5 results list with per-salon buttons, salon:0 callback → detail view with Google Maps link and Back/New Search nav. All 6 messages sent correctly. Bot runs for 12s without polling errors. Bot name is 'Gigs' (Gigs_test_12343253_bot).

failure_log.error: Claude Code process exited with code 143

tasks.title: Fix any bugs found during live testing: error handling, empty results, geocoding failures, callback query edge cases
tasks.notes: Fixed 9 bugs: (1) SEARCHING state ignores text input instead of resetting session mid-search. (2) pendingSearches Set prevents duplicate concurrent doSearch calls from double-pressing budget buttons. (3) action:back with empty salons redirects to greeting instead of crashing. (4) Overpass timeout (AbortError/TimeoutError/HTTP 429/504) surfaces as a typed timeout message and returns user to budget prompt. (5) Nominatim also gets AbortSignal.timeout(10000). (6) GPS coordinates shown as 4-decimal degrees not raw string (resolvedLocationDisplay helper). (7) salon:X callback guards wrong session states. (8) Empty results message now mentions service name and gives New Search button. (9) action:back colon split changed to indexOf to handle values that contain colons.

tasks.title: Git commit all source files, update journal.md with completion notes, update board.json task statuses to done
tasks.notes: Committed all source files (src/bot.ts, src/salonSearch.ts, src/messageFormatter.ts) with bug fixes from m4.t2. Updated board.json and journal.md. Did not commit credentials.env or node_modules. Milestone m4 complete — full Telegram beauty bot built and tested.

tasks.title: Create landing page: workspace/public/index.html — SEO, Open Graph, CTA button linking to bot, service list, how-it-works section
tasks.notes: Created workspace/public/index.html — full single-page landing site with SEO title/description meta tags, Open Graph + Twitter Card tags, pink gradient hero with CTA button linking to t.me/Gigs_test_12343253_bot, 8-service grid (nails/hair/eyebrows/lashes/waxing/massage/makeup/all), 6-step how-it-works section with numbered step cards, why-BeautyBot 4-card grid (free/Telegram/smart ranking/worldwide), second CTA footer, OSM attribution footer. Mobile-responsive with CSS grid auto-fit. No build step needed — pure HTML+CSS.

tasks.title: Enhance analytics.ts: write JSON lines to logs/usage.jsonl (file-based, append mode) in addition to stdout; create logs/ dir on first write
tasks.notes: analytics.ts already implemented file-based JSON line logging with mkdirSync (recursive) + appendFileSync. Verified end-to-end: logs/usage.jsonl is created and written on first logUsage() call. Added logs/ to .gitignore so runtime log files are not committed.

tasks.title: Add Overpass retry with exponential backoff in salonSearch.ts: 2 retries on HTTP 429/504 with 2s/4s delays; improves reliability on transient API failures
tasks.notes: Verified that salonSearch.ts already contains the full retry implementation (MAX_ATTEMPTS=3, BACKOFF_MS=[0,2000,4000]). The for-loop retries on HTTP 429 and 504 only; non-retriable errors and network errors propagate immediately. A delay() helper uses setTimeout to sleep between attempts. Added during m4.t2 bug fixes. No code changes needed.

tasks.title: Improve messageFormatter.ts: add /cancel confirmation text, improve /help with /share command mention, improve /share copy
tasks.notes: Added formatCancel() exporting a friendly HTML confirmation message. Updated /help to clarify /share description and added a tip line inviting users to share. Rewrote /share copy to be more inviting (added 'beauty concierge' positioning, added ranked-by bullets, formatted checkmarks on one line). Wired formatCancel into bot.ts replacing inline string.

tasks.notes: Created workspace/README.md with: hero section with bot link (t.me/Gigs_test_12343253_bot), feature table (7 service types), feature list (inline keyboards, GPS, budget, ranking, rich cards, one-tap actions, sessions, worldwide), full example conversation transcript, commands table, how-to-run with env vars + project structure, architecture section (search pipeline + reliability), data attribution (OSM/Nominatim/Google Places with ODbL note), tech stack.
